_doc: Named places for me.go(<name-or-slurl>) in sl.py. A place is somewhere, not just numbers. Edit freely — add a row and it's usable in-world immediately (sl.py runs as a subprocess, no restart). Each place has: name, region (SL sim), pos [x,y,z], and optional aliases. `region` per-place means go() reaches OUT of the current sim when a place lives elsewhere. To add a place, grab its SLURL from the SL viewer (World > Landmarks, or the map) and either paste it into go() directly or drop the parsed x/y/z here. Source: Jeff/Brandi's Anchorage SLURL list, 2026-08-25. Future: Brandi will bring an annotated photo to grow this into a richer 'AI-palatable' place model (see GH #300 world-model).
